records.text: Jerri Frantzve married Carl Pangerl when he was five or six years older than she was
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She gets married to a guy named Carl Pangerl. Carl Pangerl, spelled P-A-N-G-E-R-L, is five or six years her senior.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Available family obituaries identify Carl Pangerl and Jerri Pitts but do not establish their ages at marriage or the asserted five-to-six-year difference.

records.text: Carl Pangerl later became a bishop in the Mormon church
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And just so you know, he's going to go on to become a bishop in the Mormon church because marrying a child is apparently not a disqualifier. In fact, she tells us her parents welcome them back into the home.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Carl Pangerl's obituary identifies him as Bishop Carl Alan Pangerl and documents his longstanding membership in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
